title: Ikoyi Master Suite
summary: A restful master bedroom with botanical accents, layered textiles and bespoke storage.
description: Our client wanted a retreat from the city. We softened the palette, added a woven pendant and greenery, and designed concealed storage so the room stays uncluttered.
